title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Anthropic Export Control Shockwave: A US Commerce Department directive has suspended global and foreign-national access to Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models following jailbreak reports, severely disrupting AI frontier development.
Elon Musk Hits $1 Trillion: The SpaceX and Tesla CEO has become the world's first trillionaire as valuations soar, sparking widespread global reactions and contrasting with his modest lifestyle.
Google's New Agent Standard: Google has unveiled the Open Knowledge Format (OKF), a standardized directory of markdown files designed to act as a living wiki and digital brain for AI agents.

Meta's Internal AI Turmoil: Meta has restructured its AI division, cutting 10% of its workforce and drafting thousands of engineers to generate AI training data under heavy surveillance, leading to intense internal backlash.
2026 FIFA World Cup Kicks Off: The much-anticipated 2026 World Cup has begun with an opening match between Mexico and South Africa, while FIFA enforces strict kit regulations on teams like Egypt.
Geopolitical Escalation in Iran: President Trump has launched military action against Iran citing the need to eliminate its nuclear capabilities, marking a major escalation in the Middle East.

items.title: @IntCyberDigest: US Suspends Global Access to Anthropic Fable 5
items.body: Following reports of jailbreaking by Amazon researchers, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick issued an export control directive forcing Anthropic to disable global access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5. Anthropic is actively fighting the directive, which follows previous attempts by the Trump administration to delay model releases.

items.title: @scaling01: Foreign AI Researchers Locked Out of Frontier Models
items.body: The recent export control directive on Anthropic models prohibits any foreign national, including those employed by Anthropic on US work visas, from accessing Fable 5 and Mythos 5. This restriction severely cripples the productivity of frontier AI labs and threatens to shift the balance of AI leadership to global competitors like China.

items.title: @Marie_Haynes: Google Introduces Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
items.body: Google has launched the Open Knowledge Format, a standardized way to store interconnected information in markdown directories, serving as a 'digital brain' for AI agents. This protocol allows AI to easily query and edit a living wiki, potentially disrupting popular note-taking platforms like Notion and Obsidian.

items.title: @LayoffAI: Meta Reassigns 6,500 Engineers to AI Data Labeling
items.body: Amid a restructuring that cut 8,000 jobs, Meta has drafted over 6,500 engineers and product managers to write puzzles and code to train AI models. The reassignment, paired with strict keystroke monitoring for training data generation, has reportedly caused morale to plummet and prompted an internal petition from over 1,600 employees.

items.title: @Zai_org: GLM-5.2 Model Open-Sourcing Next Week
items.body: Zhipu AI has made its flagship GLM-5.2 model available to GLM Coding Plan users, featuring 1M-context support and powerful coding capabilities. The model will be officially open-sourced under the MIT License next week, reinforcing the push for open and accessible AI development.

items.title: @AlphaWizarDD: Elon Musk Becomes First Trillionaire
items.body: Elon Musk's net worth has surpassed the $1 trillion mark, making him the world's first trillionaire. The milestone highlights his immense wealth generated through SpaceX and Tesla, sharply contrasting with his famously modest lifestyle in a $50,000 prefab home in Texas.

items.title: @mark_dow: US Launches War in Iran Over Nuclear Capacity
items.body: President Trump has initiated military action against Iran, citing the need to eliminate the country's nuclear capabilities following a recent Israeli strike. The conflict marks a major escalation in a decade-long geopolitical saga that began with the cancellation of the 2015 Obama-era nuclear agreement.

items.title: @CryptoDoggyCN: SpaceX Welder's Shares Worth $1.05 Million
items.body: A former SpaceX welder has gained viral attention after it was revealed his early equity incentives of 6,500 shares are now valued at over $1.05 million. He has since transitioned to Blue Origin, demonstrating the massive financial upside for blue-collar workers in the commercial space sector.

items.title: @pangyusio: The 'Goose Leg Auntie' $3 Million Arbitrage
items.body: A street vendor famous for selling roasted 'goose legs' near Peking University was exposed after a decade for actually selling cheaper duck legs, having amassed over 20 million RMB in profit. The viral story highlights how early small business owners leveraged information asymmetry and platform traffic to build massive wealth.

items.title: @imwsl90: Global Shipping Costs Cheaper Than Local Delivery
items.body: Global logistics efficiency has reached a point where shipping a kilogram of beef 20,000 kilometers from Argentina to China costs roughly 50 cents, less than a typical local food delivery fee. This extreme cost reduction is driven by massive container ships operating in international waters.

items.title: @BarackObama: US Men's National Team Begins 2026 World Cup
items.body: Former President Barack Obama tweeted a message of support and good luck to the United States Men's National Team as they kick off their 2026 FIFA World Cup campaign.

items.title: @FOXSports: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opening Match
items.body: The 2026 FIFA World Cup has officially commenced, opening with a highly anticipated and action-packed match between Mexico and South Africa.

items.title: @MickyJnr__: FIFA Forces Egypt to Remove Jersey Stars
items.body: FIFA has mandated that the Egyptian national team remove the seven stars from their jerseys before their opening match against Belgium. The stars, which commemorate Egypt's record seven AFCON titles, violate FIFA's strict uniform regulations for the World Cup.

items.title: @TouchlineX: Kylian Mbappé Praises Rising Star Michael Olise
items.body: French football star Kylian Mbappé spoke highly of his international teammate Michael Olise, praising his elegance, vision, and grounded personality. Mbappé emphasized that despite Olise's introverted nature with the media, his extraordinary on-pitch abilities speak volumes.

items.title: @yantanzhang: SpaceX Engineer Sparks Debate on Professional Appearance
items.body: SpaceX engineer Guo Can has gone viral on Chinese social media for her casual attire and tattoos, sparking a debate about women's empowerment in STEM. Observers are questioning whether focusing on her physical appearance distracts from her technical achievements as a leading aerospace engineer.
